liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **Th' Stallion pt. 3**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [5]
- **I Wuz Nothin'**: rare: 10 archived performances [5]
- **Th' Stallion pt. 1**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [5]
- **Th' Grobe**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [5]
- **Spinal Meningitis got me Down**: back after 60 archived shows (1469 days); rare: 11 archived performances [5]
- **Devil's Dick**: rare: 11 archived performances [5]
- **Don't Get too Close to my Fantasy**: back after 46 archived shows (1093 days) [5]

## The recordings

- **ween2022-10-28.schoeps_mk41v_flac24** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 32 songs; 157 min [1]
- **ween2022-10-28.schoeps_mk22_flac24**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 32 songs; 157 min [2]
- **ween2022-10-28.elam260.mp6ii.flac**: soundboard; 32 songs; 155 min [3]
- **ween2022-10-28**: source not stated; 32 songs; 156 min [4]

## Tapers and lineage

- **ween2022-10-28.schoeps_mk41v_flac24**: taped by Andy Murray; transferred by Andy Murray; source: Schoeps mk41v>cmc1k>Sonosax SX-R4+ 24bit/96khz din PAS behind sbd dfc [1]. Also: Chain: Sonosax SX-R4+ to SD card to iMac, edited in Reaper with fades, tracking and limiting, then encoded to FLAC with XAct [1]
- **ween2022-10-28.schoeps_mk22_flac24**: taped by Andy Murray; transferred by Andy Murray; source: Schoeps mk22>cmc1k>Sonosax SX-R4+ 24bit/96khz NOS behind sbd dfc [2]
- **ween2022-10-28.elam260.mp6ii.flac**: taped by Ted Gakidis; transferred by Ted Gakidis; source: Telefunken ELA M260/TK60(DIN,DFC,@SBD) > Sound Devices MixPre6ii 24/96 [3]
- **ween2022-10-28**: taped by Rich Cuiffo; transferred by Rich Cuiffo; source: Schoeps MK41s and Schoeps MK22's> Nbob actives > Sound Devices MixPre 6 II [4]
